analysis: Both units are CHANGELOG.md head text (documentation only). This touches TB-003/T-043 (watchdog/rollback authority) operationally, but no source is supplied, so no security conclusion can be drawn; the next pass should check the actual launchd relaunch/watchdog code for unbounded waits or re-arm behavior that could leave a stale binary running (T-047-like stale-process concerns are fan-specific). Other entries (leaderboard BRIN index/503, Autopilot 0.9.16/0.9.17, status page, cache routing persistence, SSD TTL 30 min matching T-041/SEC-035 sign-off, App Attest protocol 3 only, T-031 earnings endpoint removal) appear to be pre-existing or already reflected in the canonical model.
